shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts; cat src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts'

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'chatOrchestratorUsage.test|turnUsage.test|receives collected response text and usage|\\| Status \\|' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; ls scripts/spec-links"

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- src/orchestration; git diff origin/main -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; rg -n 'it\\(' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts; rg -n 'usageTestFixture|testFixture' eslint.config*"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts#L7','chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts#L4').replace('turnUsage.test.ts#L7','turnUsage.test.ts#L4')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Preserve the unchanged no-tool regression guard', '- [x] Preserve the unchanged no-tool regression guard')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
 git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/usageTestFixture.ts && git commit -m 'Share usage test setup' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch"
